description: Credentials used by source hosting, package publishing, and infrastructure tooling.

rules.name: GitLab Access Token
rules.description: Default GitLab personal, project, and group access token prefix.
rules.recommendation: Revoke and rotate the GitLab token and use a protected CI variable or secret store.

rules.name: PyPI API Token
rules.description: PyPI API tokens use the documented pypi- prefix.
rules.recommendation: Revoke the PyPI token and prefer Trusted Publishing or a scoped replacement token.

rules.name: HCP Terraform API Token
rules.description: HCP Terraform token containing the documented atlasv1 marker.
rules.recommendation: Revoke the HCP Terraform token and use TF_TOKEN_* environment credentials.
